subject: Recap + Ops pairing request — VPC/private deployment interest
messages:
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>

Cc: Ava Gupta <ava.gupta@finlytics.com>
Date: Sat, 15 Aug 2026 14:03:00 -0700
Subject: Recap + Ops pairing request — VPC/private deployment interest

Hi Samir / Ava,

Thanks again for the call this morning — good to get an initial read on FinLytics' latency and compliance requirements. Quick recap and suggested next steps so we have alignment:

- Priority: your team flagged low-latency scoring for customer-facing features (95th pctl target ~120ms) and a compliance preference for VPC or on-prem isolation for payment data.
- Use case surface: real-time scoring + nightly batch embeddings refresh for search.
- Recommended path: start with a small dedicated pool (reserved capacity) to validate throughput and cost, then evaluate a Private VPC pilot for data isolation if audit/KMS needs are confirmed.

Next steps I propose:
1) Ops pairing session (30–45m) where Marissa (solutions eng) and I walk through topology options, required network access, and a pilot checklist.
2) Share the VPC checklist and a short dedicated pricing summary (attached).
3) Customer to confirm priority/timing window — are you targeting a pilot before end of Q4?

Can you share a couple of 30-min windows next week that work for you? If you prefer, here's my booking link: https://cal.redwood.com/marcus/30min

Attachments: redwood-dedicated-pricing.pdf (pricing + sizing), vpc-checklist.xlsx (network & compliance items)

Thanks,
Marcus Lin
Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference
marcus.lin@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0147

---
P: On the call we also discussed potential SSO/KMS needs — if those are firm we can bring our security engineer into the pairing.
